$$\vec{v}(t) = \vec{v}_C(t) + \vec{v}'(t) \Rightarrow$$

$$v_C(t) = \frac{Fl}{4m}, \quad v_1'(t) = \frac{F}{4m}\sqrt{\frac{3m}{2k}}\sin\sqrt{\frac{3k}{2m}}t, \quad v_2'(t) = \frac{F}{4m}\sqrt{\frac{m}{2k}}\sin\sqrt{\frac{3k}{2m}}t$$

$$E_p = \frac{1}{2}k(l - 2x)^2 = \frac{1}{2}kl^2(1 - 2\sin\theta)^2$$

$$E_k = 2\times\left(\frac{1}{2}mv_1'^2 + \frac{1}{2}mv_2'^2\right) = 2\times\frac{1}{2}J_p\omega^2 = 2\times\frac{1}{2}ml^2\dot{\theta}^2 = ml^2\dot{\theta}^2$$

$$E = E_k + E_p = \frac{1}{2}kl^2(1 - 2\sin\theta)^2 + ml^2\dot{\theta}^2$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}E}{\mathrm{d}t} = -2kl^2(1 - 2\sin\theta)\cos\theta\dot{\theta} + 2ml^2\dot{\theta}\ddot{\theta}$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}A}{\mathrm{d}t} = F\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = F\frac{\mathrm{d}(l\sin\theta)}{\mathrm{d}t} = Fl\cos\theta\dot{\theta}$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}A}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}E}{\mathrm{d}t} \Rightarrow (1 - 2\sin\theta)\cos\theta - \frac{m}{k}\ddot{\theta} = -\frac{F}{2kl}\cos\theta$$

$$1 - 2\sin\theta_0 + \frac{F}{2kl} = 0, \quad \sin\theta_0 \approx \sin30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}, \quad \cos2\theta_0 \approx \cos60^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$$

$$\ddot{\delta} + \frac{3k}{2m}\delta = 0$$

$$x = l\sin\theta = l\sin(\theta_0 + \delta) = l\sin\theta_0 + l\cos\theta_0\delta = x_0 + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}l\delta$$

$$\Delta = x - x_0 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}l\delta$$

$$\ddot{\Delta} + \frac{3k}{2m}\Delta = 0$$

questions.content:
（2.1）个量子态上的平均粒子数：$f(\varepsilon) = e^{\frac{\varepsilon - \mu}{kT}}$。

个能量为 $\varepsilon_n$ 的能级上的粒子数：$N_n = C D_n e^{-\frac{\varepsilon_n - \mu}{kT}}$。

系统的总粒子数：

$$N = \sum_n \omega_n e^{-\frac{\varepsilon_n - \mu}{kT}} = \frac{1}{2} e^{\frac{\mu}{kT}} \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (n+1)(n+2) e^{-(n+\frac{3}{2})\frac{\hbar\omega}{kT}}$$

$$\mu = kT \ln \frac{2kT}{\sum\limits_{n=0}^{\infty} (n+1)(n+2) e^{-(n+\frac{3}{2})\frac{\hbar\omega}{kT}}}$$

$$\varepsilon_n = (n+\frac{3}{2})\hbar\omega, \quad \omega_n = \frac{1}{2}(n+1)(n+2)$$

一个能量为 $\varepsilon_n$ 的能级上的粒子能量：$U_n = \varepsilon_n N_n = \omega_n \varepsilon_n e^{-\frac{\varepsilon_n - \mu}{kT}}$。

系统的总能量（内能）：

$$U = \sum_n \omega_n \varepsilon_n e^{-\frac{\varepsilon_n - \mu}{kT}} = \frac{1}{2} e^{\frac{\mu}{kT}} \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (n+1)(n+2)(n+\frac{3}{2}) \hbar\omega e^{-(n+\frac{3}{2})\frac{\hbar\omega}{kT}}$$

![](data/images/2023-c1218eb3/2023-珍题集训-第四套-32.jpg)

$$\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (n+1)(n+2) e^{-(n+\frac{3}{2})\frac{\hbar\omega}{kT}} = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n^2 e^{-\frac{n\hbar\omega}{kT}} \approx \int_0^{\infty} n^2 e^{-\frac{n\hbar\omega}{kT}} \mathrm{d}n$$

令 $x = \frac{n\hbar\omega}{kT}$，则

$$\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (n+1)(n+2) e^{-(n+\frac{3}{2})\frac{\hbar\omega}{kT}} \approx \left(\frac{kT}{\hbar\omega}\right)^3 \int_0^{\infty} x^2 e^{-x} \mathrm{d}x = 2\left(\frac{kT}{\hbar\omega}\right)^3$$

$$\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (n+1)(n+2)(n+\frac{3}{2}) e^{-(n+\frac{3}{2})\frac{\hbar\omega}{kT}} \approx \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} n^3 e^{-\frac{n\hbar\omega}{kT}} \approx \int_0^{\infty} n^3 e^{-\frac{n\hbar\omega}{kT}} \mathrm{d}n = 6\left(\frac{kT}{\hbar\omega}\right)^4$$

$$\mu = 3kT \ln \frac{N^{1/3}\hbar\omega}{kT}$$

$$U = 3NkT$$

![](data/images/2023-c1218eb3/2023-珍题集训-第四套-33.jpg)

（3.2）

$$N = \sum_{n=0}^{n_{\max}} \omega_n = \frac{1}{2} \sum_{n=0}^{n_{\max}} (n+1)(n+2) = \frac{1}{2} \sum_{n=0}^{n_{\max}} n^2 \approx \frac{1}{2} \int_0^{n_{\max}} n^2 \mathrm{d}n \approx \frac{1}{6} n_{\max}^3$$

$$n_{\max} = (6N)^{1/3}$$

$$\mu(0) = \varepsilon_{n_{\max}} = (n_{\max} + \frac{3}{2})\hbar\omega \approx n_{\max}\hbar\omega = (6N)^{1/3}\hbar\omega$$

$$\varepsilon_n = (n+\frac{3}{2})\hbar\omega, \quad \omega_n = \frac{1}{2}(n+1)(n+2), \quad f(\varepsilon) = \begin{cases} 1, & \varepsilon < \mu(0) \\ 0, & \varepsilon > \mu(0) \end{cases}$$

![](data/images/2023-c1218eb3/2023-珍题集训-第四套-34.jpg)

$$U = \sum_{n=0}^{n_{\max}} \varepsilon_n \omega_n = \frac{1}{2} \sum_{n=0}^{n_{\max}} (n+1)(n+2)(n+\frac{3}{2}) \hbar\omega \approx \frac{1}{2} \hbar\omega \sum_{n=0}^{n_{\max}} n^3 \approx \frac{1}{2} \hbar\omega \int_0^{n_{\max}} n^3 \mathrm{d}n = \frac{1}{8} n_{\max}^4 \hbar\omega = \frac{3}{4} N(6N)^{1/3}\hbar\omega$$

questions.content:
（1）半径为 $R$、折射率为 $n$ 的玻璃半球，球心为 $O$，平面朝下。一束平行光竖直向下入射到半球平面上，距中心轴 $r$ 处的光线经平面折射后射向球面，求光线在球面上不折射（发生全反射）的临界条件，并证明当 $r=R/n$ 时球面上出射光线与入射光线平行。

（2）一束光强为 $P$ 的平行光垂直照射到折射率为 $n$ 的半球平面上，求半球受到的光压力。

（3）长为 $l$、质量为 $m$ 的均匀细杆，一端用光滑铰链悬挂，另一端自由。初始时杆竖直下垂，受到微小扰动后绕铰链转动。求杆转到与竖直方向成 $\theta$ 角时的角速度 $\omega$ 和角加速度 $\beta$，并证明 $\beta_1=\beta_2-\omega_2^2\cot\theta$。
